row.notes: Collects available TrackDataRecord pointers into the 8-byte vector out {alloc, begin, end, cap} (grows 1.5x through the allocator vt+0x18). With an empty filter (stat_id_bytes +0x08 == +0x10) it walks every record of TrackDataSystem +0x28..+0x30 (16-byte items, null skipped); otherwise for each filter byte it takes the record whose index byte (+0x01) equals it. A record is skipped when hidden (+0x2d8 != 0) or, unless the current game mode ([[[sys+0x228]+0x30]+0x88]+0x260) is or derives from RTTI 0x146129ca0, when the entitlement check 0x1437d2410(sys+0x228 owner, mode, record+0x78) fails. Callers: Sess_Apply_ContentAvailability (0x1413e4e78) and Sess_Load_TrackDatabase (0x142e5db56) - corrected from 2 Apply sites (V3665).

Skip if byte record+0x2d8 != 0; mode = [[[tds+0x228]+0x30]+0x88]+0x260, RTTI walk vs 0x146129ca0/0x146129ca8, else 0x1437d2410(tds+0x228 owner, mode, record+0x78) (0x142e5dd40). Push record ptr into out 8-byte vec, grow 1.5x via allocator vt+0x18 (0x142e5dd66-0x142e5dd93).
